# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2), as of Oct 2026

**Best overall for most iPhone users: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three of the roundups pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical slats can sag.
- The roundups don't give a direct Belkin purchase link. The Amazon buy buttons are on [RottenWiFi's guide](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) and [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/).

**Best for speed and reliability: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (AirCool)**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan). Mount Guys uses it as their daily driver, and it's the one pick with a two-year warranty, per [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).
- The price is $89.99 in most sources, and The Gadgeteer lists a $69.99 sale price.
- It's a vent clip mount and isn't compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles. Only recent iPhones get the full 25W: the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus reach 25W, the 16 and 16 Pro reach 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. Two say a 60W adapter is in the box, while RottenWiFi says you need your own 45W+ adapter. Confirm the box contents before buying.
- Details are in [Mount Guys' review](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/).

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- A built-in fan helps stop throttling when you run maps while charging. It's Qi2 certified and mounts on a vent or the dash.
- [ESR's own store price is $39.99](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost), and code PARTNER18 brought it to $32.80 in a cart test on 2026-10-22. This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. Codes can change, so confirm at checkout.
- A car adapter may not be included. The Gadgeteer says the 18W adapter isn't, and ESR's page doesn't say. Budget $10–15 for one.
- The Gadgeteer lists this mount at $18.99, $35.99 and $39.99 in different places, so check the current price.

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan, about $39.95:** The Gadgeteer's top pick for iPhone 16/17, with a 95W adapter included. It uses a suction base on the dash or windshield.
- **LISEN 15W (vent plus dash), about $15.99–$26.79:** A cheap entry option, but it's not Qi2 certified as far as these listings show. Without Qi2 certification, expect slower charging.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99:** Qi2 15W with no fan, so it may throttle in direct sun.
- **Non-charging, strong hold:** Mount Guys likes the VICSEED steel-core vent mount if you don't need charging.

**Quick picks**
- Want simple and complete: **Belkin**.
- Have a newer iPhone and hot dashboard: **Anker Prime** or **LISEN 25W**.
- Want cooling on a budget: **ESR CryoBoost**.

Which phone do you have, and is your vent horizontal or vertical? That would help me narrow it down.
